import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.BasisLinear
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

lemma sum_evenShift (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

lemma evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero : @evenShiftZero n = evenFst 0 := rfl

lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n) := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

lemma evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc (j : Fin n) : evenShiftSnd j = evenSnd j.castSucc := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]
  ring_nf
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  ring

/-- The first part of the basis as charges. -/
def basisAsCharges (j : Fin n.succ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

/-- The second part of the basis as charges. -/
def basis!AsCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenShiftSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

lemma basis_on_evenFst_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basisAsCharges]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_self (j : Fin n) : basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basis!AsCharges]

lemma basis_on_evenFst_other {k j : Fin n.succ} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basisAsCharges k (evenFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenFst, evenSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

lemma basis_on_other {k : Fin n.succ} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenSnd k) : basisAsCharges k j = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp_all only [ne_eq, ↓reduceIte]

lemma basis!_on_other {k : Fin n} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenShiftFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenShiftSnd k) : basis!AsCharges k j = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp_all only [ne_eq, ↓reduceIte]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_other {k j : Fin n} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basis!AsCharges k (evenShiftFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp only [evenShiftFst, succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat, add_right_inj] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

lemma basis_evenSnd_eq_neg_evenFst (j i : Fin n.succ) :
    basisAsCharges j (evenSnd i) = - basisAsCharges j (evenFst i) := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenSnd, evenFst]
  split <;> split
  any_goals split
  any_goals rfl
  any_goals split
  any_goals rfl
  all_goals
    rename_i h1 h2
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1 h2
    simp_all
  all_goals
    rename_i h3
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h3
    simp_all
  all_goals omega

lemma basis!_evenShftSnd_eq_neg_evenShiftFst (j i : Fin n) :
    basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftSnd i) = - basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst i) := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenShiftSnd, evenShiftFst]
  split <;> split
  any_goals split
  any_goals split
  any_goals rfl
  all_goals rename_i h1 h2
  all_goals rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1 h2
  all_goals simp_all
  · subst h1
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  all_goals rename_i h3
  all_goals rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h3
  all_goals simp_all
  all_goals omega

lemma basis_on_evenSnd_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenSnd j) = - 1 := by
  rw [basis_evenSnd_eq_neg_evenFst, basis_on_evenFst_self]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftSnd_self (j : Fin n) : basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftSnd j) = - 1 := by
  rw [basis!_evenShftSnd_eq_neg_evenShiftFst, basis!_on_evenShiftFst_self]

lemma basis_on_evenSnd_other {k j : Fin n.succ} (h : k ≠ j) : basisAsCharges k (evenSnd j) = 0 := by
  rw [basis_evenSnd_eq_neg_evenFst, basis_on_evenFst_other h]
  rfl

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftSnd_other {k j : Fin n} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basis!AsCharges k (evenShiftSnd j) = 0 := by
  rw [basis!_evenShftSnd_eq_neg_evenShiftFst, basis!_on_evenShiftFst_other h]
  rfl

  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  split<;> rename_i h

    Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_eq_zero, Fin.coe_natAdd] at h
    omega
  · split <;> rename_i h2
    · simp only [evenShiftZero, succ_eq_add_one, Fin.isValue, evenShiftSnd, Fin.ext_iff,
      Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_eq_zero, Fin.coe_natAdd] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftLast (j : Fin n) : basis!AsCharges j evenShiftLast = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  split <;> rename_i h

/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]

    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

    · intro i

  rfl

  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by

    · intro i

  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]

  ring_nf
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.BasisLinear
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

lemma sum_evenShift (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

lemma evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero : @evenShiftZero n = evenFst 0 := rfl

lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n) := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

lemma evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc (j : Fin n) : evenShiftSnd j = evenSnd j.castSucc := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]
  ring_nf
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  ring

/-- The first part of the basis as charges. -/
def basisAsCharges (j : Fin n.succ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

/-- The second part of the basis as charges. -/
def basis!AsCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenShiftSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

lemma basis_on_evenFst_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basisAsCharges]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_self (j : Fin n) : basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basis!AsCharges]

lemma basis_on_evenFst_other {k j : Fin n.succ} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basisAsCharges k (evenFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenFst, evenSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

lemma basis_on_other {k : Fin n.succ} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenSnd k) : basisAsCharges k j = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp_all only [ne_eq, ↓reduceIte]

lemma basis!_on_other {k : Fin n} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenShiftFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenShiftSnd k) : basis!AsCharges k j = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp_all only [ne_eq, ↓reduceIte]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_other {k j : Fin n} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basis!AsCharges k (evenShiftFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp only [evenShiftFst, succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat, add_right_inj] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

lemma basis_evenSnd_eq_neg_evenFst (j i : Fin n.succ) :
    basisAsCharges j (evenSnd i) = - basisAsCharges j (evenFst i) := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenSnd, evenFst]
  split <;> split
  any_goals split
  any_goals rfl
  any_goals split
  any_goals rfl
  all_goals

    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1 h2
    simp_all
  all_goals
    rename_i h3
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h3
    simp_all
  all_goals omega

  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenShiftSnd, evenShiftFst]

  any_goals split
  any_goals rfl

  all_goals simp_all

    exact Fin.elim0 i
  all_goals rename_i h3
  all_goals rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h3
  all_goals simp_all
  all_goals omega

  rw [basis_evenSnd_eq_neg_evenFst, basis_on_evenFst_self]

  rw [basis!_evenShftSnd_eq_neg_evenShiftFst, basis!_on_evenShiftFst_self]

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.BasisLinear
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

lemma sum_evenShift (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

lemma evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero : @evenShiftZero n = evenFst 0 := rfl

lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n) := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

lemma evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc (j : Fin n) : evenShiftSnd j = evenSnd j.castSucc := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]
  ring_nf
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  ring

/-- The first part of the basis as charges. -/
def basisAsCharges (j : Fin n.succ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

/-- The second part of the basis as charges. -/
def basis!AsCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenShiftSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

lemma basis_on_evenFst_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basisAsCharges]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_self (j : Fin n) : basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basis!AsCharges]

lemma basis_on_evenFst_other {k j : Fin n.succ} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basisAsCharges k (evenFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenFst, evenSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

lemma basis_on_other {k : Fin n.succ} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenSnd k) : basisAsCharges k j = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp_all only [ne_eq, ↓reduceIte]

lemma basis!_on_other {k : Fin n} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenShiftFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenShiftSnd k) : basis!AsCharges k j = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp_all only [ne_eq, ↓reduceIte]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_other {k j : Fin n} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basis!AsCharges k (evenShiftFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp only [evenShiftFst, succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat, add_right_inj] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

lemma basis_evenSnd_eq_neg_evenFst (j i : Fin n.succ) :
    basisAsCharges j (evenSnd i) = - basisAsCharges j (evenFst i) := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenSnd, evenFst]

  any_goals rfl
  any_goals split

    simp_all

    rename_i h3
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h3
    simp_all
  all_goals omega

    basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftSnd i) = - basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst i) := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenShiftSnd, evenShiftFst]
  split <;> split
  any_goals split
  any_goals split
  any_goals rfl

  all_goals rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h3

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.BasisLinear
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

lemma sum_evenShift (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

lemma evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero : @evenShiftZero n = evenFst 0 := rfl

lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n) := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

lemma evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc (j : Fin n) : evenShiftSnd j = evenSnd j.castSucc := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]
  ring_nf
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  ring

/-- The first part of the basis as charges. -/
def basisAsCharges (j : Fin n.succ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

/-- The second part of the basis as charges. -/
def basis!AsCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenShiftSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

lemma basis_on_evenFst_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basisAsCharges]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_self (j : Fin n) : basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basis!AsCharges]

lemma basis_on_evenFst_other {k j : Fin n.succ} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basisAsCharges k (evenFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenFst, evenSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

lemma basis_on_other {k : Fin n.succ} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenSnd k) : basisAsCharges k j = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp_all only [ne_eq, ↓reduceIte]

lemma basis!_on_other {k : Fin n} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenShiftFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenShiftSnd k) : basis!AsCharges k j = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp_all only [ne_eq, ↓reduceIte]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_other {k j : Fin n} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basis!AsCharges k (evenShiftFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp only [evenShiftFst, succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat, add_right_inj] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

lemma basis_evenSnd_eq_neg_evenFst (j i : Fin n.succ) :
    basisAsCharges j (evenSnd i) = - basisAsCharges j (evenFst i) := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenSnd, evenFst]
  split <;> split
  any_goals split
  any_goals rfl
  any_goals split
  any_goals rfl

    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1 h2
    simp_all
  all_goals
    rename_i h3
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h3
    simp_all
  all_goals omega

lemma basis!_evenShftSnd_eq_neg_evenShiftFst (j i : Fin n) :
    basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftSnd i) = - basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst i) := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenShiftSnd, evenShiftFst]
  split <;> split
  any_goals split
  any_goals split
  any_goals rfl
  all_goals rename_i h1 h2
  all_goals rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1 h2
  all_goals simp_all
  · subst h1
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  all_goals rename_i h3
  all_goals rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h3
  all_goals simp_all
  all_goals omega

lemma basis_on_evenSnd_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenSnd j) = - 1 := by
  rw [basis_evenSnd_eq_neg_evenFst, basis_on_evenFst_self]

  exact?

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.BasisLinear
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

lemma sum_evenShift (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

lemma evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero : @evenShiftZero n = evenFst 0 := rfl

lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n) := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

lemma evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc (j : Fin n) : evenShiftSnd j = evenSnd j.castSucc := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]
  ring_nf
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  ring

/-- The first part of the basis as charges. -/
def basisAsCharges (j : Fin n.succ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

/-- The second part of the basis as charges. -/
def basis!AsCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenShiftSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

lemma basis_on_evenFst_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basisAsCharges]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_self (j : Fin n) : basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basis!AsCharges]

lemma basis_on_evenFst_other {k j : Fin n.succ} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basisAsCharges k (evenFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenFst, evenSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

lemma basis_on_other {k : Fin n.succ} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenSnd k) : basisAsCharges k j = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp_all only [ne_eq, ↓reduceIte]

lemma basis!_on_other {k : Fin n} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenShiftFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenShiftSnd k) : basis!AsCharges k j = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp_all only [ne_eq, ↓reduceIte]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_other {k j : Fin n} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basis!AsCharges k (evenShiftFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp only [evenShiftFst, succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat, add_right_inj] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

lemma basis_evenSnd_eq_neg_evenFst (j i : Fin n.succ) :
    basisAsCharges j (evenSnd i) = - basisAsCharges j (evenFst i) := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenSnd, evenFst]
  split <;> split
  any_goals split
  any_goals rfl
  any_goals split
  any_goals rfl
  all_goals
    rename_i h1 h2
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1 h2
    simp_all
  all_goals
    rename_i h3
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h3
    simp_all
  all_goals omega

lemma basis!_evenShftSnd_eq_neg_evenShiftFst (j i : Fin n) :
    basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftSnd i) = - basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst i) := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenShiftSnd, evenShiftFst]
  split <;> split
  any_goals split
  any_goals split
  any_goals rfl
  all_goals rename_i h1 h2
  all_goals rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1 h2
  all_goals simp_all
  · subst h1
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  all_goals rename_i h3
  all_goals rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h3
  all_goals simp_all
  all_goals omega

lemma basis_on_evenSnd_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenSnd j) = - 1 := by
  exact?

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.BasisLinear

/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

lemma evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero : @evenShiftZero n = evenFst 0 := rfl

lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n) := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

lemma evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc (j : Fin n) : evenShiftSnd j = evenSnd j.castSucc := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]
  ring_nf
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  ring

  fun i =>

    else

that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.

universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ

    exact h2

    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]

    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

lemma sum_evenShift (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]

  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,

  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]

  ring

  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]

  simp [basis!AsCharges]

    basisAsCharges k (evenFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenFst, evenSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat] at h2

    (h2 : j ≠ evenShiftSnd k) : basis!AsCharges k j = 0 := by

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_other {k j : Fin n} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basis!AsCharges k (evenShiftFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp only [evenShiftFst, succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftSnd]
  split

  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl

    have h2 := h2 j

    exact h2

  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]

  apply congrArg

  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i

    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]

  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,

  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

lemma evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc (j : Fin n) : evenShiftSnd j = evenSnd j.castSucc := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]
  ring_nf

  fun i =>

      - 1
    else
      0

def basis!AsCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenShiftSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

lemma basis_on_evenFst_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basisAsCharges]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_self (j : Fin n) : basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basis!AsCharges]

lemma basis_on_evenFst_other {k j : Fin n.succ} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basisAsCharges k (evenFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenFst, evenSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat] at h2

    · rfl

    (h2 : j ≠ evenSnd k) : basisAsCharges k j = 0 := by

lemma basis!_on_other {k : Fin n} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenShiftFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenShiftSnd k) : basis!AsCharges k j = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_other {k j : Fin n} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basis!AsCharges k (evenShiftFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp only [evenShiftFst, succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftSnd]

    basisAsCharges j (evenSnd i) = - basisAsCharges j (evenFst i) := by

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i

    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]

  rfl

    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by

    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.BasisLinear
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

lemma sum_evenShift (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

lemma evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero : @evenShiftZero n = evenFst 0 := rfl

lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n) := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

lemma evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc (j : Fin n) : evenShiftSnd j = evenSnd j.castSucc := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]
  ring_nf
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  ring

/-- The first part of the basis as charges. -/
def basisAsCharges (j : Fin n.succ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

/-- The second part of the basis as charges. -/
def basis!AsCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenShiftSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

lemma basis_on_evenFst_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basisAsCharges]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_self (j : Fin n) : basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basis!AsCharges]

lemma basis_on_evenFst_other {k j : Fin n.succ} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basisAsCharges k (evenFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenFst, evenSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

lemma basis_on_other {k : Fin n.succ} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenSnd k) : basisAsCharges k j = 0 := by
  exact?

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.BasisLinear
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n) := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]

  fun i =>

    else
      0

def basis!AsCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenShiftSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

lemma basis_on_evenFst_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basisAsCharges]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_self (j : Fin n) : basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basis!AsCharges]

lemma basis_on_evenFst_other {k j : Fin n.succ} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basisAsCharges k (evenFst j) = 0 := by
  exact?

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.BasisLinear
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]
  ring_nf
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  ring

  fun i =>

  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenShiftSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

  simp [basisAsCharges]
